items.question: What identity was relinquished when the fisherman-natured mind was abandoned?
premises: The Brahma-state was indeed abandoned at that time.
The abandonment concerns a fisherman-natured mind.
The mind is directly addressed in the statement.
items.inference: Relinquishing the fisherman-natured mind entails the abandonment of the Brahma-state.
uncertainties: Whether citta functions as a vocative address or as part of the subject phrase is contextually ambiguous.
items.plain_english: Indeed, then the Brahma-state was abandoned, O mind, along with its fisherman-nature.
